run_preprocess_char_lm: run the script to preprocess WikiText-103 dataset for building a character-level n-gram language model with kenlm
process_word: process a word by lowercasing it and printing space-delimited characters if all chars are alphabetic
process_line: process a line of text by tokenizing words and printing space-delimited characters for each valid word
word_in_vocabulary: check if all characters in a word are lowercase alphabetic characters in the LM vocabulary
main: run the main CLI command that loads WikiText-103 and preprocesses all text lines for kenlm consumption
